name: Furuya Misora
source:
Main character of episode 2
A woman currently working as a janitor in the vigilante office, where [url=/c92661]her husband[/url] works as the highest rank officer.
Suffering from a rather extreme case of absentmindedness, Misora only noticed [url=/c92661]her husband[/url] and [url=/c92658]her daughter[/url]'s disappearance a long time after its occurrence. As she couldn't trace her memory during that time and information from other vigilantes was to no avail, Misora decided to seek help from the URH.
Despite the suffering, Misora is a kind and gentle person. Upon hearing that [url=/c92637]Rei[/url] and [url=/c92638]Aruru[/url] not yet have a place to stay during their investigation, she offers them a stay-in at her house.
